summary: DeepSeek-V4.1 compressed KV cache records are bit-identical to the reference quantizer
compatibility: No user action required. Existing caches stay valid; newly written records differ only where a value sat exactly between two FP4 codes.
details: The 288-byte FP4 (E2M1 + E4M3 scale per 16) writer divides by the group scale like DeepSeek's fp4_quant_kernel instead of multiplying by a rounded reciprocal, so exact E2M1 midpoints round to the even code.
About 0.05% of cached values change by one FP4 step to the equally distant neighbour; model quality and speed are unchanged.
